packageRules.description: Merge everything except major automatically once CI passes. Patch is listed for the security fixes that still open; the patch rule below skips the rest. Branches are only created on Mondays (top-level schedule); vulnerability alerts keep their own immediate schedule.

Major updates may break things, so always merge them by hand, and only open one after approval on the Dependency Dashboard: an open major takes the single open-PR slot and holds up every other update.

Skip patch updates to keep PRs and GitHub Actions usage low. Security fixes still get PRs because vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled=true is forced onto alert updates and re-enables them. Dependabot alerts are off in this repo, so OSV (osvVulnerabilityAlerts) is the alert source.

bun is pinned in mise.toml (CI), packageManager, and constraints.bun (the bun Renovate installs for bun.lock; the renovate-config manager bumps it). A bun.lock written by a newer bun than CI's can fail --frozen-lockfile
The VRT job runs the Playwright server image against the catalog's client, which refuses a different version, and the browser cache key must name the version the client downloads

worker-configuration.d.ts records the workerd version bundled with wrangler, so CI's cf-typegen --check fails until it is regenerated. The regeneration runs wrangler from node_modules, so a full bun install comes first: bun dedupe only installs when it removes a duplicate

customManagers.description: Update versions in bun workspaces.catalog in package.json

Playwright versions that no manager extracts: the VRT server command and browser cache key in CI, and the local test:vrt task. config:recommended ignores every test/ directory, so ignorePaths drops that to reach .mise-tasks/test/vrt
